Commentary.Commentary: After electing to bowl, Ireland got off to a perfect start by dismissing the Pakistan openers early. However, Asad Shafiq dug in well and scored a good half ton. A flurry of wickets in between saw Pakistan in a spot of bother at 159 for 6 but a 117-run stand between Faheem Ashraf and Shadab Khan bailed their side out of stutter and put the visitors in a healthy position. Tim Murtagh was the most impressive of the bowlers as he bagged a four-fer. The rest though could not pose a lot of problems with the old ball and they are now staring down a first innings total which is a little above par. Will the Ireland batters come to the fore or will the Pakistan pace attack get the better of them? Stay tuned to find out.

PAKISTAN HAVE DECLARED WITH 310 ON THE BOARD! They do have a good enough total on a wicket which has something in it for the bowlers to exploit. They have added 42 runs to their overnight tally this morning and lost three wickets. Once again it was the new ball which did the trick for the Irish bowlers. They got Shadab Khan early but Faheem Ashraf continued batting with the tail. He stitched another handy stand with Amir before he departed to a peach of a delivery and missed out on a deserving ton bu just 17 runs.
Shorter in length and aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Abbas defends it onto the ground.
Attacks the stumps now and gets it to shape away. The batsman tries to defend but it goes off the edge and along the ground to the slip fielder.
Good length outside off, Abbas tries to defend it away from his body bets gets beaten.
Shortish in length and outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Swings again but this time he does not connect.
FOUR! A wild swing, the ball takes the edge of the bat and goes over the slip cordon for a boundary. Handy runs for Pakistan and frustrating ones for Ireland.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length and on off, Ali blocks it out.
On a length around off, once again the batsman leaves it.
Outside off, Ali makes a leave.
Fuller and on the stumps, the batsman gets right behind it and keeps it out.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Length again on the pads, Abbas tries to defend but gets beaten and is hit on the pads.
The ball has found the edge of the bat.
Third in a row! This is on the fuller side outside off. Abbas tries to go big but does not connect.
Fuller this time and swinging away. Abbas goes for the drive but again gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, this one shapes away a touch. Abbas makes room and hangs his bat out but gets beaten.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Rahat Ali is the last man in.

OUT! Two-in-two overs for Ireland. Tim gets his fourth and the end is now nigh for Pakistan. This is fuller and on off, it shapes away a touch. Amir goes for a loose drive, like he has been doing through out his innings. This time though the ball takes the outside edge and it's a simple catch to Niall O'Brien behind.
Another one slanting away from the batsman. Amir tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Amir pushes it through backward point for a brace.
On the pads, works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Amir defends it solidly.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length on off, Abbas first thinks of defending it but then tries to pull his bat out of the way. He is late in doing so and the ball hits the bottom edge and goes to third slip.
Mohammad Abbas is the new man in.

OUT! Faheem's luck runs out! He gets an absolute peach. Just how do you play those? Ashraf surely did not have an answer. This lands on a length around the leg pole. It shapes away and also shoots off the surface. Ashraf is surprised by the extra bounce and tries to defend it with his bat hanging out. The ball though takes the edge and goes into the mitts of Niall O'Brien who takes it this time. So a good outing for the debutant comes to an end. He falls 17 short of a century but he too has done his job.
On a length and on the pads, Amir works it through mid-wicket for a run.
The line is way outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Short and this is slapped through point. There is a fielder in the deep so only a single results.
Shorter in length outside off, the batsman chops it to covers.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Attacks the stumps this time and Ashraf defends it onto the ground.
Hits the length hard on off, it angles away from the left hander. He pushes at it and gets beaten.
OOOO! This is on the fuller side and outside off. Amir goes for the booming drive but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Amir defends it solidly.
Good length and on off, Faheem guides it through point and gets to the other end.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length and on off, it is punched to covers.
Wide outside off, the batsman does not fiddle with it.
On the pads, the batsman misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Length again on off, Amir defends it.
Good length outside off, it is left alone.
Stuart Thompson is back on.
Good length on middle, it is tapped towards covers and the batsmen set off for a run. The fielder comes running in and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
On a length around off, slanting away. The batsman thinks about playing at it but pulls out of the shot.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length on off, Amir defends it onto the ground.
Fuller and outside off, Amir tries to go downtown but does not connect.
Shorter in length on off, defended solidly.
Short again on off, the batsman evades it this time.
Hits the length hard on off, Ashraf defends it onto the ground.
Length around off, punched to the man at covers.
Short again and on off, Amir rocks back and punches it through covers. Some good running by the batsmen see them get three.
Short again, this time the pull shot is not middled. They also have a man at the back and only a run is taken.
FOUR! Cracked! Short and it sits up to be hit. Faheem rocks back and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, driven back to Murtagh who gets low in his followthrough and stops it.
Short of a length, close to the off stump line, Amir pushes it away with an angled blade towards point.
Goes fuller and serves it outside off, Faheem lunges ahead and with pats it through point for a single.
Tries to bring this back in from around off, Ashraf solidly keeps it out off the back foot.
Lands it on a length around middle, Ashraf shuffles across and defends it on the leg side.
Keeps it full and around middle, defended solidly off the front foot.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
On a length and around middle, the batsman nudges it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Beaten! Length again on off, it slants away from the batsman. He pushes at it but does not connect.
Fullish on off, it is driven to the man at mid off.
Good length on middle, this one comes back in. The batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fullish and on off, Ashraf squirts it through point and gets a brace.
Back of a length on off, defended.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball, but fails.
Good length around off, this one shapes back in. Ashraf defends it with bat and pad close to each other. The bowler appeals thinking it is pad first but the umpire shakes his head.
Good length on off, defended.

DROPPED! We have seen quite a few drops in the slip cordon by the Irish fielders and here is another. This is on a length around off, this one shapes away. Ashraf tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards Andy McBrine at third slip. He dives to his left to take it but can't hang on. The debutant has rode his luck along. This is the third time he has gotten a life.
In the air... but short! The bumper on middle, the batsman goes for a pull but gets a top edge towards deep square leg who collects it on the bounce. A run taken by the batsmen.
On a length around off, blocked.

EDGY FOUR! Amir gets off the mark but not in a convincing fashion, he will take it though. Full and on off, Amir goes for the drive but it goes off the edge and through the slip cordon for a boundary. Handy runs are these for Pakistan.
Length ball outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Another play and a miss! On a length and outside off, slanting away. The batsman goes for the drive but gets beaten.
Fuller and wider outside off, Amir goes for the booming drive but gets beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The sucker ball outside off, Ashraf goes after it but gets beaten.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Top shot! This is fuller and on off, Ashraf leans into it and times it through mid off for a boundary.
Good delivery! On a length around off, this one pitches and moves away from the batsman. Ashraf tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
Good length on off, defended.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
On middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fires a full ball outside off, Ashraf tries to drive it through the off side but does not connect.
Good length around off again, Ashraf blocks it.
Good start by Rankin! On a length around off, this one shapes away after pitching. Ashraf tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
Another ball a little too wide outside off, left alone. Had to make the new batsman play there, two poor deliveries by Tim.
Outside off, left alone.
Mohammad Amir comes out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! The new ball has done the trick. A big, big breakthrough for Ireland and a much-needed one. They have broken the 117-run stand. An inswinger from Murtagh, he comes running in and bowls it on a length around off, it tails back in late. Shadab is unable to counter it as he goes for the flick across the line. Misses it and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Replays show it would have gone down the leg side but sadly, there is no DRS for this game. Shadab Khan departs early today, he though has done his job. Can Ireland now make quick work of the tail?
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards covers for a quick run.
So Ireland have decided to take the new cherry now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Once again the ball does not bounce a lot. It is on a length around off, it slants away. Faheem first tries to play at it but then pulls his bat out.
The second new ball is available but it has not been taken as of now. Tim Murtagh is brought into the attack for the first time today.
Back of a length on off, the batsman punches it to the man at covers.
On a length around off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Fuller on off, Ashraf strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length outside off, the batsman punches it through covers for a run.
Wide outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Slightly short and outside off, it is slapped to the man at deep point for a run.
Wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

EDGED AND JUST SHORT! The slow nature of the wicket saved Faheem there. It was on a length around off, it slants away from the batsman. Ashraf tries to defend but gets an outside edge which falls just short of the diving second slip fielder. He makes a good stop though, a run taken.
Once again it is outside off, Ashraf lets it be. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Length ball around off, Faheem taps it towards point and wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
BEATEN! The bowler bowls it full and outside off, wanting the batsman to go for a loose stroke. He does as he goes for a drive away from his body and gets beaten.
Once again outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
Outside off, left alone.
First run for Ashraf today! He guides it through point and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length on off, Ashraf pushes it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Ashraf misses out on the flick and it goes on the bounce to the keeper.
On the shorter side and outside off, Khan rocks back and punches it through point for a run.
Stuart Thompson to bowl from the other end.
A yorker to end the over. Ashraf digs it out.
Another one outside off, tempting the batsman to go for a drive. The batsman resists and lets it be.
First run of today! Another length ball around off, Khan pushes it towards point for a run. That is poor by Ireland, giving such easy singles away. They should be attacking a little more.
This is one is on the fuller side but the line is way outside off. The batsman does not need to play at those.
Length ball and this time on the stumps, Shadab Khan defends it onto the ground.
Starts off with a full toss, a low one. This one does swing a little away from the batsman. Khan drives it to the man at covers.

Bright sunshine welcomes us, that's good start to the day! The players make their way out to the middle. The two overnight batsmen will resume their innings. Shadab Khan is on strike and he will face Tyrone Kane who will start the proceedings. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Ireland, on the other hand, will try and bundle the opposition out quickly. The new ball will be available in four overs and one would expect it to be taken quickly as it was with the new ball that the Irish bowlers looked more threatening. So what will we have in store for us today? Will Pakistan strengthen their position or will the Irish come roaring back?

Hello and welcome to what is called as the 'moving day' in Test cricket, Day 3, between Ireland and Pakistan in Dublin. We have hardly had a full day's play but the forecast for today is quite good. The game is slightly in favor of Pakistan courtesy the stand between Faheem Ashraf and Shadab Khan. Both have brought up their respective fifties and they would look to add some more runs quickly today and get closer to the 300-run mark.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The Irish bowlers were very good at the start but lost steam as the day progressed. They did have Pakistan on the mat but could not capitalize and just let the game drift away. Also, their fielding was not up to the mark as they dropped a couple of catches which has hurt them big time. Still they can feel proud with the way they have announced themselves in this format. They need to break this stand quickly to restrict the visitors under 300. Pakistan, on the other hand, will hope that the current pair can bat for as long as possible to help them post a good total. The forecast for tomorrow is pretty good. Do join us for the coverage at 1100 local time (1000 GMT). Till then you can switch over to the Indian T20 League where Bangalore are asked to chase down a huge total. Cheers!

The inevitable has happened as it started to rain while the players were walking off the field. STUMPS on Day 2! We lost the whole day yesterday and we have lost 22 overs today, all due to the bad weather. Pakistan though will be the happier side as they find themselves in a strong position going into Day 3. They were in a spot of bother at 159 for 6 but an unbeaten hundred-run stand for the seventh wicket between Shadab Khan and Faheem Ashraf, with both scoring half tons, has made them believe they can get up to the 300-run mark, which at one stage looked far-fetched.

It has gone really dark out there. The two umpires are seen having a word and they have decided to walk off. The precautionary covers have been brought in. Not good signs, these! Also, we can hear some thundering as the players trudge back. A good call by the umpires to take them off. Seems like that should be it as the light won't be improving from here. Still let us wait for the official confirmation...
Flat and quick on the stumps, Faheem Ashraf hangs back in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! First of the match! What a hit! That is right in the zone for Faheem, it's full and on middle, Ashraf tonks it over long on for a biggie.
Floats it up on off, Ashraf defends it onto the ground.
Loopy ball on off, it is driven through covers for a run.
Flatter on middle, Khan defends it.
The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.

Full and wide outside off, it is driven uppishly through backward point. The batsmen run two and Ashraf wants the second but slips as he goes for it. He recovers well and completes it as the fielder fires a throw to the keeper.

The 100-run stand comes up now! These two seem to have taken the game away from Ireland with this brilliant partnership. Ashraf flicks the ball through square leg and bags a brace. A fist punch is shared by them.
Fullish and on middle, driven back towards the bowler.
Another ball wide outside off, left alone.
Wide outside off, guided towards point.
Maiden Test fifty for Shadab Khan as well. Gets down and does the Sajda! Truly deserving, well played! Waits for the ball to come and then dabs it behind point for a couple of runs.
Works it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on off, kept out towards covers for a run.
Flatter on off, punched to covers for a run.
Shortish and outside off, it is cut to point.
Straightaway brings the sweep shot out but finds the fielder at backward square leg.
Paul Stirling is into the attack. A spinner for the first time today.
Fullish on off, Ashraf gets it off the toe end towards mid off.
Length around off, defended solidly.
Full again and outside off, wanting the batsman to go for a booming drive. He resists and lets it go through to the keeper.
Fullish and outside off, left alone.
Back of a length on off, it is tucked to the man at mid-wicket.
Length outside off, left alone.
Kevin O'Brien is back on.
And again. Seems like after scoring 18 runs in the previous over Pakistan batsmen are happy to cool down now.
Another one in the channel, another leave.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.
Shadab makes a good leave as it was a wide delivery.
Stays put and punches it past cover for a couple.
Wide outside off, nothing doing.

Fifty on debut for Ashraf! He's had is luck but then you need to make the most of it and this man certainly has. A raise of the bat from him and the entire Pakistan dressing room lauds the effort. Comes forward to a fuller ball and drives it through cover to celebrate his milestone. 18 off the over, a real big one.
FOUR! Make that fourth one! Fuller and strayed on the pads, all Ashraf had to do was to get some bat on it. He does with a fine tickle down the leg side.
FOUR! Shot! This is turning out to be a huge over! Another one on the shorter side, Faheem slaps it past gully for the third boundary of the over.

FOUR! Edged and dropped! Niall O'Brien what have you done? It was a simple catch to Wilson at first slip. Chance goes down abegging and this will only hurt Ireland! Back of a length, angling away a touch, Ashraf looks to go after it but gets an edge. It flies behind but Niall O'Brien dives to his left to take it. The ball goes off his gloves and then races down to the third man fence for another boundary. Had he not dived, it would have been a dolly to Wilson.
Beaten! On a length and outside off, Ashraf comes forward to defend but misses.
FOUR! Nicely placed! Short of a length delivery outside off, Ashraf places his cut past the man at gully for a boundary to start the over.
Almost chops it on! A length ball outside off, Shadab goes for a push but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, the batsman chops it to the man at point.
On a length around middle, kept out.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Digs in a short delivery on middle, Ashraf is a bit early into his pull shot and hence gets it off the toe end of the bat as the ball rolls back towards Rankin.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched towards cover.
Short of a length around leg, Ashraf hops and taps one besides the pitch.
Punches this length delivery square on the off side for a single.
The groundsmen are seen taking their place as it has gone really dark now...
Decks back in sharply with some bounce, Khan fails to defend as the ball goes off the pads and goes towards the slip cordon.

FOUR! Authoritative! Short of a length delivery on middle, it sits up to be hit and Shadab Khan dismisses it from his sight. Swivels a touch and nails the pull through mid-wicket. No stopping that. Moves to 45 with that blow!
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads The fielding side is asking the question. The umpire shows no interest in the appeal.
NO BALL! He bowls it down the leg side. Khan goes for the flick but the ball brushes the pads. Goes through the hands of the diving keeper and down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller and outside off, left alone.
On middle, worked with the angle to mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Stuart Thompson is back on.
The batsman gets a bottom edge on that one.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.

In the air... but lands in no man's land. Short and on the body of the batsman. It bounces a touch more. Khan tries to defend but the ball hits the high portion and lobs towards the off side. A run taken.
Shortish and on middle, the batsman defends onto the ground.
Down the leg side, the batsman misses the flick.
Shortish and on off, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
FOUR! That is brilliant from Faheem. A shot with which any top order batsman would be proud of. Full and on off, Faheem shows the full face of the bat and times it through mid off for a boundary.
Length ball around off, kept out.
Very full and on middle, flicked down to fine leg for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge to the man at gully.
A yorker and on off, Khan jams it out to mid off.
Fullish in length and on off, it is stroked to covers.
A yorker on off, the batsman digs it out.
Short and outside off, Ashraf goes for the cut but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Fullish and on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
On middle, worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Shortish and outside off, punched through point for a run.
Fuller on the stumps, driven to the man at covers.
Wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Fuller in length outside off, swinging away further. Shadab makes a leave.
Short again outside off, it has been slapped through covers and the batsmen get two.
Back of a length on off, pushed to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Ashraf defends it to mid off.
Another full ball which is driven to the man at mid off.
Fuller again on middle, the batsman prods forward and keeps it out.
Fuller on middle, eased to mid on.
Length ball on middle, Ashraf defends it off the back foot.
On the pads, Ashraf flicks it through square leg and runs two.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Top shot! Slightly short and enough room on offer for Shadab Khan as he rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary to raise the 50-run stand between the two.
BEATEN! Fuller and again swinging away. Khan as a feel for it but does not connect.
Wide outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Good length on off, it is pushed to the man at mid off.

A huge appeal but nothing from the umpire. Fuller and on off, the batsman goes for the drive but he seems to have missed it. The keeper takes a diving catch to his right and appeals. The umpire though shakes his head as he indicates the bat has hit the ground.
On a length around middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length around off, blocked.
Comes forward to a fuller delivery and drives it towards cover.
Good length around off, defended.

Edged and dropped! Dear me! Murtagh has his hands on his head! He angles away a fuller length delivery outside off, Faheem Ashraf looks to drive but gets an edge which goes down low towards first slip where Wilson fails to hold onto it. Will this prove to be costly?
Fuller delivery on off, pushed to mid on.
Tim Murtagh to bowl from the other end.

EDGY FOUR! Beautifully bowled was that one. Full and shaping away on off, Khan lunges forward and goes for the drive but the ball takes the outside edge. Beats the diving fielder at third slip and into the fence.
Shorter in length outside off, Khan pushes it through point and bags a brace.
On a length around middle, pushed to mid on.

FIVE OVERTHROWS! Bonus for Pakistan. This is on a length around off, the batsman taps it towards point and sets off for a run. The fielder there comes running in, picks the ball up and fires a wild throw at the bowler's end. It misses the stumps and the fielder backing up can't stop it and it races away. 200 up for Pakistan.
On a fuller length and outside off, Ashraf lets it be.
FOUR! First runs of this session and it is in the form of a boundary! Poor ball outside off and on a shorter length. Ashraf cuts it through backward point and the ball races away.
Starts off with a length ball around off, the batsman pushes it to the man at point.

We are back for the final session. 39 overs left so we are in for a long one. Shadab Khan and Faheem Ashraf will resume their innings. Tyrone Kane will bowl the first over after the break. Here we go...
...Day 2, Session 3...

Pakistan batters aren't willing to spend time in the middle. Only Asad Shafiq showed the eagerness to bat out there but he failed to convert his fifty into a big one. Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed's wicket must have sent a fear in their dressing room but the current pair of Ashraf and Khan has done well to avoid further hiccup and took them through to Tea. Will these two be able to bat for some more time and take the total to somewhere near 250 or will the Irish bowlers nip out the remaining wickets quickly? Join us in a bit for the final session which will be a long one.

Another good session for Ireland! They broke the stand between Sohail and Shafiq quickly after the Lunch interval and since then they have continued to chip away at the wickets. All their bowlers have been pretty disciplined and got the rewards for the same. Rankin and Murtagh were the ones doing the job but Thompson put his hands up in this session and contributed with a couple of wickets to his name as well. Just towards the end, they seemed to have been a bit wayward but otherwise, it's a clinical show from their bowlers.
Gets a glove this time! Another one down leg, Shadab Khan tries clipping it away but gets it off the gloves which goes on the bounce to Niall O'Brien behind. TEA ON DAY 2!
Spills one down leg, Khan fails to put that away.

Half-a-shot but no harm done! On a length and outside off, Faheem stays back and decides to leave but the ball comes back in and he had to play. Gets it off the outer half of the bat past the slip cordon. The fielder gives it a chase and does well to pull it back in play. Three taken!
Drives a fuller delivery nicely but finds Stirling at short cover.
Short of a length delivery outside off, chopped towards the fully fielder.
Fullish in length and around off, Ashraf defends it solidly off the front foot.
There is a halt in play. Some issue with the sightscreen and it's getting fixed...

Good running! On the pads, a whippy drive through backward square by Ashraf. They run two and see the fielder is a bit late to charge and decide to go for another. Complete three with ease and these two have now added 31 runs between them.
Goes back and punches it square on the off side for a single.
On a length and outside off, Khan is in two minds as to what to do. Leave or play. Attempts for the latter and nearly plays the price.
In the same channel, Shadab shows resistance.

FOUR! Edged and there is no third man! So frustrating for the bowler, this1 Fuller and attacking the stumps, Khan goes at it with hard hand but gets a thick edge which flies between backward point and gully for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Slammed! Short of a length delivery outside off, Shadab's eyes light up as he cuts it hard behind point and the ball races away to the third man fence.
Fuller outside off, driven through cover for one.
Nipping back in on middle, Shadab Khan brings his bat down in time and keeps it out.

This is even better from Ashraf! Leans nicely into a fuller ball outside off and unfurls a cracking drive through the cover. The ball doesn't go all the way due to the slow outfield but enough the fetch him three.

FOUR! Punched down the ground! Good length delivery on middle and off, Faheem Ashraf stands tall and punches it off the middle down the ground. The man from mid on and mid off give it a chase but the ball still wins the race. First boundary in Test cricket for Ashraf, special feeling!
Gets across and pushes this full delivery towards cover.
Fuller delivery to begin with, Ashraf eases it to mid on.
Kevin O'Brien is brought into the attack now.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leans ahead a touch and works it towards square leg.
Slants it wider again, Ashraf has a wild slash at it. Beaten!

An appeal for a caught behind! Fires it full and wide outside off, Faheem crouches low and tries to squeeze it out through cover but seems to have missed it completely. There was a noise as the ball passed the bat which got the Irish going. They all appeal but it's rightly turned down as the noise of the bat hitting the ground.
Stays back in the crease and pats it away safely.
This one comes back in from outside off, Ashraf plays it a bit uppishly towards mid off.
Slightly fuller outside off, Khan takes a stride ahead and makes a leave.
Moves back and across as he blocks it away towards the cover region.
Very full ball outside off, a mistimed drive towards mid off.
Goes deep in the crease and dabs it towards backward point.
Fuller in length and on middle, pushed to mid on.
On a length and outside off, Khan slaps it to deep point and hares across for a double.
Faheem Ashraf makes a good leave to end the over.
Works this fuller delivery wide of the man at mid on and runs one.
Takes a stride ahead and eases the drive towards mid off.
Covers the line on this one and shows a straight bat in defense.
Good length ball on middle and leg, worked towards mid on for nothing.
Faheem Ashraf gets off the mark! Clips this length delivery through square leg and runs one.
Stays back and punches it to the man at cover.
Lets this length delivery outside off settle into the mitts of the keeper.
Comes forward and drives it through cover for a couple of runs.
On a length and outside off, Shadad Khan tries to push it away but gets an edge which lands just short of Stirling at second slip.
FOUR! Crashed! This man can bat! Short of a length delivery outside off, Shadab scythes it through point to send it across the rope in a jiffy.
Kane comes back into the attack and bowls a fuller delivery outside off, left alone.
A snorter to welcome the debutant! Back of a length, slanting away a touch with some bounce. Ashraf has a waft at it only to be beaten.
Faheem Ashraf, the debutant is in next.

OUT! There goes another! And this time it's the Pakistan skipper who falls, leaving his side in some more trouble now. This was actually a shocking shot to be honest. Slightly on the shorter side outside off, Sarfraz tries to guide it down but does so away from the body. There is a bit of extra bounce which takes the outer portion of the bat and goes into the bucket-like-hands of Paul Stirling at second slip who accepts his second catch. Ireland continue to chip away at the wickets. Can they bowl Pakistan out today?
Walks down a couple of steps and tucks it in front of the man at mid-wicket. Looks to steal a single but won't get it.
Replica of the previous delivery.
Watches this delivery till the last moment before letting it be.
Good length delivery outside off, Ahmed waits for it and then at the last moment, he opens the face of the bat to guide it to the slip cordon. Soft hands!
After bowling a fuller delivery, Rankin pounds in a short ball. Khan ducks!
FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller delivery on off, Shadab Khan lean forward and nails the drive down the ground for a delightful boundary. Supreme!
Spills one down leg, Khan misses his attempted flick shot.
Shadab gets on top of the bounce as he dabs it towards gully. Wants a single but it is not on.
Serves it in the avenue of apprehension, SK has got nothing to do with that one.
Good length delivery on the stumps, blocked back to the bowler.
Shadab Khan tucks this towards mid on and scampers across for a single.
Gets behind the line and defends it down safely.
Gets forward to a fuller delivery and pushes it to mid off.
Angles it in from around off and then shaping away, Khan has a poke at it and gets beaten completely.
Fuller and straying down leg, Khan leaves it.

That was a weird attempt from the Pakistan leggie! Short of a length delivery outside off, Khan at first looks to cut but then doesn't go after it. Keeps his bat out and luckily for him the ball doesn't take the edge behind.
Stuart Thompson is back on.
Bumper on middle and leg, Sarfraz is happy to sit under it.
Shadab works it towards mid-wicket and is up and running straightaway.
Shadab Khan is the next man in.

OUT! Straight to the man! This around the wicket angle works for Ireland as they get the set batsman Asad Shafiq. He can't believe what just happened and walks back with his head down. Rankin digs in a short delivery on middle and leg, Asad rocks back to pull and hits it well but finds Andy Balbirnie at square leg who takes the catch over his head. Good field placement and the visitors have now lost half their side.
Leg bye! Shortish around leg, Ahmed fails to clip that away as the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side and they cross.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Sarfraz gets on top of the bounce and drops it down on the pitch.
Short of a length delivery on leg, Ahmed is quick to sit under it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Defends this fuller delivery off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ahmed guides it behind square on the off side for a single.
Holds its line outside off, Sarfraz shoulders his arms.
Short and outside off, slapped to deep point for a single.

Good length delivery outside off, Shafiq steers it behind point and comes back for a couple. Oh wait, the umpire spots that Shafiq has no completed the second run and hence only a single will be considered.
A short ball too end the over, Sarfraz ducks under it.
Changes his length and lands it on a length around off, Sarfraz defends it.
Too predictable now! Fourth bumper in a row. Sarfraz quite easily ducks under it.
Short again, Shafiq pulls it down to fine leg for just a single.
Another bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it.
Comes around the wicket and bangs it short. Shafiq is up for it though as he pulls it to the man at square leg.
Walks down the track and tucks it towards mid on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide outside off, Shafiq lets it be.

FOUR! Streaky! Full marks to the bowler there but runs to the batsman. On a length around off, this one shapes away a touch. Asad prods forward and tries to defend but takes the outside edge and goes through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Goes back to bowling length does the bowler around off, Shafiq keeps it out.
FOUR! Classy! Fuller in length and on off, Asad leans into it and times it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled with aplomb! Short of a length delivery on middle, Sarfraz is up for the challenge as he swivels and pulls it firmly through backward square leg for a boundary to end the over.
Hops back and across and tucks it away towards square leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hangs back to a length delivery and defends.

That's fifty for Asad Shafiq, his 19th in Tests! He's looked good since the moment he's stepped in and has got to a milestone. Needs to carry on though. Shortish delivery on middle, pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the leg stump line, Shafiq fails to flick it away.
No ball! Starts this over from around the wicket and hurls in a short of a good length delivery on middle, Asad shows a tight defense.
Fuller in length on off, it is driven to mid off.
Wide outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Fuller on off, Ahmed drives it to mid off.
Fullis outside off, Ahmed lets it be.
Fuller but a little too straight. Ahmed works it towards mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a good stop.
On middle, Asad works it through square leg and takes a run.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor from the keeper! A ball down the leg side, Sarfraz misses the flick and the ball hits his pads. It goes towards the keeper who misfields and concedes a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

EDGED AND OVER! How many times have we seen this today. Once again the extra bounce almost does the trick. Shorter in length on middle, this one shoots off the surface. Sarfraz tries to defend it off the back foot but the ball takes the edge and lobs over gully for a run.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.
Similar length delivery on middle, the batsman jumps and defends it down.
Shorter in length on off, Asad hops and taps it to covers.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
A peach to end the over! Similar to the last delivery, pitches around off and the turns away sharply. Ahmed once again lunges to defend it but gets beaten.

Beauty! This is where Kane should bowl on cosistent basis. On a length around off, this one swings away after pitching. Sarfraz has to play at that one as he tries to keep it out off the front foot. But the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Tucks it around the corner with the angle and gets to the other end.
Bowls it on a length around off, Asad guides it towards gully.
Kane pays the price for bowling too full. He is driven through covers, not to the fence but the batsmen still run three.
Fuller in length on off, Asad lunges forward and pushes it towards covers for a run.
Leans ahead and blocks it out solidly off the front foot gently.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Tim angles this one in at first and then gets it to curl away a touch. Sarfraz Ahmed has a push at it with soft hands but it still takes the outside edge. It doesn't carry to the third slip fielder but sneaks through the gap between him and second slip and scoots away to the third man fence.
Sarfraz defends it from within the crease.
Punches a length ball through cover, pierces the gap and takes a brace.

Almost rolls back onto the stumps! Heart in mouth moment for the Pakistan skipper! Ahmed comes a step ahead and defends it with soft hands. However, the ball threatens to roll back on the stumps as Sarfraz tries to turn around quickly and shoo it away.
This one holds its line outside off, Ahmed leaves it unharmed.
Very full outside off, Asad hits it hard but a good dive from the fielder at cover denies him a certain boundary. Good fielding!
Good length delivery on off, presses forward and defends.

FOUR! Edged and over! That was a loose shot from a set batsman! Fuller ball, sprayed a touch wider outside off, Shafiq goes for a booming drive and gets an edge. Much to his delight it evades a leaping Porterfield, who is so sharp at gully for a boundary.
Looks to work this one on the leg side but gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller and wider outside off, asking the batter to go after him. Sarfraz obliges as he reaches out to that one and drives it past the cover fielder for a couple.
A full toss outside off, Shafiq drives it towards cover where the fielder dives and parries it further. They take one.
Tyrone Kane into the attack now.
Short of a length delivery on middle, defended well. A successful ove from Murtagh!
Shuffles a bit and works it to mid-wicket.
The Pakistan skipper gets off the mark as he hits this length delivery through cover and adds a brace.
Sarfraz walks across to a length ball and smothers it away.
Sarfraz Ahmed is in next.

OUT! Finds the edge this time! So a run out chance missed on the previous delivery doesn't cost much. Disciplined bowling from Tim and he gets his second of the game. Angles it in from around off and this one moves away ever so slightly. Babar Azam with hard hands tries to push this one but gets a thick edge which flies into the safe hands of Paul Stirling at second slip who catches it and then throws it up in the air to celebrate. So Azam walks back for not much.

Chance of a run out! Shafiq taps this length delivery besides the pitch on the off side and sets off. Porterfield from gully charges in towards the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Tell you what, had that hit, Babar Azam would have been a goner.
Babar Azam tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side but fails.
Fullish and on the pads, worked fine down the leg side for a single.
Nudges this with soft hands to square leg and gets to the other end.
Babar Azam shuffles across and doesn't offer any shot. Wears it on the pads as the ball runs away on the leg side. They cannot steal one as no shot was offered.
This one decks in sharply, Azam is a bit late in bringing his bat down. Somehow manages to keep that one out.
Shortish delivery, angling in, tapped in front of the man at mid-wicket for a brisk single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but  it doesn't hit.
Hangs back to back of a length delivery and keeps it out towards the off side.
Wider line outside off, ignored by Babar.

FOUR! Partial stop but not enough to save a boundary. Murtagh arrows in a fuller delivery on middle, Azam leans ahead and bunts it past the non-striker. The man at mid on puts in a dive to his left, gets a hand to it but the ball still wins the race.
Clips one off the pads through square leg for a single.
Has got nothing to do with the one served in the tempting zone.
In the vicinity outside off, Shafiq points his bat skywards to make a leave.
Another one strangled down the leg side, Babar once again fails to put that away.
Rankin is struggling a bit to find right lines. Slips one down leg and Azam can't make any connection.
Doesn't get carried away, that is what you want from a batter in this format. Defends it down on the off side.

FOUR! This is even better! Growing in confidence! Boyd goes short, goes wide and goes for a boundary. Azam slaps it square on the off side and it beats the man at point with utmost ease. Back-to-back boundaries and that should get Azam going now.
FOUR! Easy peasy for Azam! He needed a boundary to get into the act and Rankin feeds him with a delicious one. On the pads and he walks across to glance it behind square on the leg side. Stylish!
Starts his spell with a short of a length delivery outside off, dabbed with an open face of the bat, finds gully.
Boyd Rankin is brought into the attack for the first time in this session.
Strayed on the pads, it's clipped fine down the leg side for a single. He's off the mark, Babar.
Leans across and meets this fuller length delivery with a compact defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Fullish in length and outside off, Azam presses ahead to defend but this one shapes away and beats the outside edge.
Gets across to a fuller ball and clips it towards the man at mid-wicket.
Tucks this back of a length delivery around the corner for a single.
Shot! Short of a length ball outside off, crunched off the back foot through the gap at cover. Sluggish outfield means that he will have to settle for three runs.
Angles in a fuller delivery on the pads, Shafiq clips it towards mid-wicket.
This one is served outside off, Asad Shafiq has got nothing to do with that one.
Overpitched on off, driven nicely but straight to the man at cover.
Length ball on middle, answered with a straight bat.

FOUR! Just over the slip cordon! What bounce for Thompson! This one just took off. Shafiq hangs back in the crease to keep it out but is taken aback by the extra lift off the surface. Gets a thick edge which flies over the slip cordon for a streaky boundary.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, Tim Murtagh gets across to flick it away but it goes off the pads past the keeper and they run two leg byes.
Outside off, left alone.

Now a huge shot for an LBW! This one decks back in from outside off, Azam fails to put bat on ball and wears it on the pads. The umpire, however shakes his head to the appeal that has been raised. Impact was outside the line, I reckon!
Edgyyyy! On a length and around off, it straightens a touch and squarer Azam up completely. Babar has a poke at it and edges one towards gully but luckily for him it lands short of the man there.
A bit fuller in length and hurled on middle, Babar brings his bat down and pushes it to the man at mid on.
Harmless length delivery outside off, Azam lifts his bat to let it be.
This one moves away just a touch, Shafiq presses ahead and defends it down well.
Good length around off, pushed towards cover.
Leans forwards a touch and pushes it with an angled blade to point.

FOUR! Thrashed! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short of a length delivery, wider outside off and it's a hit-me delivery. Asad Shafiq gets on top of the bounce as he latches onto this one. Cuts it fiercely behind point for a blazing boundary.
Stands tall to a back of a length delivery and stabs it out.
Short of a good length delivery outside off, Asad hops a touch and taps it down on the surface.
Could have been a maiden for Tim but he drifts one down the leg side. Shafiq helps it down to fine leg to keep strike.
Once again delivers a fuller length delivery, Shafiq presses forward and pushes it towards cover. Wants a single but it is not on.
Fuller and angling in on middle, wristed towards the man at mid on.
Keeps it full and on the stumps, it's pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Slightly fuller and served on off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Pitches it up on middle and off, defended down into the ground.
Babar Azam is the new man in.

OUT! That's a good low catch from William Porterfield! Perfect start for Ireland after the Lunch break as they break the 58-run stand. Thompson provides the breakthrough. He drops it a bit short and angles it wider outside off. Could have easily left it alone but Sohail for some reason has a feel for it away from the body. The ball catches the outside edge of his bat and flies low towards gully where the Irish skipper bends forward to grab it inches above the ground. Stuart runs towards the slip cordon in delight as he opens his account in Test cricket.
A bit short and around middle and off, Sohail stays back in defense.
Nipping back in on middle and leg, Haris gets across and clips it off the pads behind square on the leg side for a comfortable couple.
Angles it away outside off, shouldered arms to.
Drops it on a back of a length outside off, Sohail punches it towards cover.
Slants it away on a fuller delivery, Sohail tries to drive it through the line but fails to get any wood on it.
No ball! Good length ball on middle and leg, tucked in front of the square leg fielder. Stuart has overstepped and hence it's called as a no ball.
Stuart Thompson will run in from the other end.
Nicely lunges forward and across and works it to the man at short mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, Shafiq squirts it off the inner half to square leg.
Beaten! Fuller delivery, shaping away a touch, Shafiq presses ahead to defend as he has a tentative poke at it. Is lucky not to edge one behind.
Coming back in on middle and leg, clipped a bit uppishly through backward square leg for a single. First run of the session.
Good line! Tempting delivery, in the channel outside off, Haris makes a watchful leave.
Fuller in length from over the wicket, around middle and leg, Sohail prods ahead and bunts it back to the bowler.

We are back after the break. Asad Shafiq and Haris Sohail will continue their innings. Tim Murtagh will start the proceedings in this session for the home side. Two slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2...

An excellent recovery by Pakistan has seen the session end on equal terms. It all started brilliantly for Ireland after winning the toss and electing to have a go with the ball. Their new ball bowlers, Rankin and Murtagh justified their captain's decision by sending both the openers back in the hut early. But then Sohail and Shafiq joined forces and battled through the tough period. Once the ball got old, the two found run-scoring easy and have stitched an unbeaten 54-run stand to not let the hosts run away with the show. Pakistan would want these two to continue and make it a big one. Ireland, on the flip side, will hope to break this stand and create further inroads. Join us for the second session in a while.

Excellent effort in the field! A length ball on off, it shapes away a touch. The batsman tries to keep it out but the ball flies off the edge through backward point. Murtagh from the slip cordon, hares after it and at the very last moment pushes it back into the field. Saves a run for his side. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
A good short ball on middle, Sohail ducks under it.
Shortish this time, the batsman rocks back and blocks it comfortably.
On a length and outside off, the batsman lets it be.
Another length delivery on off, Haris defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, kept out off the back foot.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one.

Shortish and outside off, Asad gets on top of the bounce and places his cut shot through point to collect a brace. The fifty-run stand is up and it is a vital one for Pakistan as the two walked out when their team was in trouble. Good recovery!
Kevin has not got it right here. He bowls this one down the leg side.
Down the leg side, swinging away further. The keeper dives to stop it but only manages to get a hand to it. The batsmen run a bye.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
On a length around off, Sohail blocks it out.
Poor ball on the pads, Sohail works it around the corner for a run.
Hits the length around off, Sohail is watchful in defense.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Errs in line and pays the price. On the pads, flicked through square leg and the ball races away.
On a length but once again the line is outside off. Left alone.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
On the pads, tucked around the corner for another run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Nudged down to fine leg by the batsman. They pick up a single.
On a length this time, gets the ball to bounce a touch more. It also swings away. Asad tries to defend but the ball goes off the top portion of the bat and on the bounce to gully.
Fullish on off, the batsman drives it to mid off.
Kevin O'Brien is back on.
Another ball outside off, the batsman does not fiddle with it.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Fullish in length and outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, worked around the corner for a run.
On the middle stump, Asad gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
On the pads, Asad works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter in length and outside off, Sohail punches it through covers and bags a brace. So runs now coming quickly here for Pakistan.
Hits the length hard on off, Sohail blocks it.
Wrong line! On the pads, Sohail loves it there. He flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Fuller in length on middle, it is driven back to the bowler.
Good running! On a length around middle, the batsman taps it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Shorter in length on off, Sohail punches it to point. That was right from the middle but straight to the fielder.
Fullish on middle, Haris flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller in length on off, defended solidly.
On a length around middle, defended back to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, kept out by the batsman off the back foot.
Fullish in length. The ball does shape back in but it is bowled outside off. Sohail makes a leave.
Comes forward to a fuller ball and blocks it out to the cover region.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside of, easily left alone.
Good delivery! In the channel outside off, Shafiq presses ahead to defend but this one shapes away to beat the outside edge.
Good length ball outside off, Shafiq shoulders his arms to that one.
FOUR! Slapped hard! A bit short and served with a lot of width outside off. Shafiq makes the most of it as he cracks it through point for a boundary.
Tyrone Kane is back on.
Works it through square leg with the angle for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Very wide outside off, almost a wide but this time the umpire does not signal one.
Fullish on off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Slashed and slashed hard! Short and outside off, Shafiq throws the kitchen sink at it. He gets an outside edge which goes over the slip cordon and into the third man fence.
Very wide outside off. The batsman makes a leave. It was so wide that the umpire signals it as one. Not often do you see a bowler has been signaled for a wide in a Test game.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Stuart Thompson comes into the attack.
A couple to end the over! A little too full this time on off, the batsman strokes it through covers for a brace.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Fuller on off, Sohail drives it through covers for a brace.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Sohail misses the flick.
Outside off, the batsman makes a leave.
This was better from the bowler. He bowls it a little too close to the off pole but the batsman does not play at it. A maiden but not a threatening one.
Another outswinger but once again it is outside off. Shafiq plants his front foot forward and makes a leave.
Fuller in length on off, defended.
Better from the bowler. He attacks the stumps this time. Asad defends it onto the ground.
Fuller and swinging away. Shafiq makes a leave.
Too wide outside off, the batsman need not go after that one.
On a length outside off, Sohail makes a confident leave. The two batsmen out there look well settled now.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Down the leg side, Shafiq misses the flick. The ball goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Another leave as the bowler bowls it too wide outside off.
Outside off and left alone.
Good length around middle, the batsman tries to tuck it away but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length on off, it is pushed towards cover. The fielder there makes a half stop and a single is taken.
Good length on off, defended.

EDGED BUT FOUR! Pakistan will take it anyway it comes as run-scoring has not been easy for them. Full and on off, this one shapes away a touch. Shafiq goes for the drive but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through backward point for a boundary.
Three runs! This is fuller and on off, Sohail pushes it through covers. Due to the rain yesterday, the outfield is a touch slow and hence it does not go all the way. The batsmen run three.
Good length outside off, left alone. Kane is a little wayward, needs to get his line right here.
This one is outside off and the batsman leaves it alone.
Good length on middle, Shafiq tires to work it across the line but closes the face of the bat a little too early. He gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length on off, kept out.
Down the leg side, Asad misses the flick to get hit on the pads. There is a muted appeal from the bowler but the umpire shakes his head. Going down leg.
Back of a length on off, Shafiq leaves it alone.
Boyd Rankin is back on.
Fuller in length and outside off, Sohail makes second leave in a row.
This one is way outside off and the batsman need not play at those.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Goes full again on off, Sohail drives it to mid off.
FOUR! A little too full and Kane pays the price. A half-volley on off, Sohail times it through mid off and there is no stopping that one. So two boundaries for Ireland in space of three balls.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! This should break the shackles now! Fuller in length on off, Shafiq just leans into it and strokes it through mid off for a boundary.
This one is angled into the pads, Shafiq works it to short leg.
This time it is outside off, Shafiq leaves it alone.
Play and a miss again! The swing here is troubling the Pakistan batsman. On a length around off, this one shapes away a touch. Shafiq prods forward to keep it out but gets beaten.
This one shapes in a touch and it is bowled on a length. Sohail tries to block it but it goes off the inner half towards fine leg for a run.
Good length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Looks to tap and run but the cover fielder is quick to attack the ball and deny them. A maiden for Kane.
Is rightly behind the line and stabs it out with a compact defense.
Beauty of a delivery! Lands it on a length around off, it straightens a touch. Shafiq stays back to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. So close...
In the channel outside off, Asad makes a good leave.
Gets across to an outswinger and dabs it away towards gully.
Fuller and curling away sharply, the line is outside off which allows Shafiq to make an assured leave.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point. Tidy over!
Short of a length delivery, closer to off stump, Sohail makes another leave.
Gets right behind the line of this one and blocks it out solidly.
Sees the line outside off and makes a good leave.
Beaten again! Fullish again, moving away a bit, Haris once again lunges forward to have a feel and is beaten all ends up.
Slants it away on a fuller length outside off, Sohail presses forward to defend but the ball leaves him to beat the outside edge of his bat by just.
Gets forward and across to a fuller ball and blocks. A good first over from Kane.
That's the fourth leave in a row. Outside off, nothing doing, says Asad.
Keeps it on a fuller length outside off, nicely shouldered arms to.
Another one sprayed a touch wider outside off, easily left alone once more.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
No run.
No ball to begin with! Short of a length delivery outside off, Sohail taps it in front of cover and hares across for a quick single. Kane has overstepped and hence will have to reload it.
Tyrone Kane into the attack now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. End of a wicket maiden.

BEATEN! This has been a brilliant over! Actually a brilliant bowling display by the two bowlers. This is on a length and around off, once again it shapes away. Shafiq hangs his bat out and gets beaten.

Edged but short! The Ireland players have their tails up. This is on a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Shafiq tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and falls just short of gully who dives forward and collects it.
Outside off, Shafiq makes a confident leave.

Almost a third wicket. A direct hit was needed there. This length ball is pushed towards point by Shafiq. The non-striker wants a run but is sent back by his partner. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Replays show had he hit, Sohail was well short.
Asad Shafiq is the next man in.

OUT! Two-in-two for Ireland. What a start to Test cricket for them. They have sent both the openers back in the hut now. It is the inswinger which does the trick this time. Full and tailing back in late. Imam tries to keep it out but does not account for the inward movement. He misses and the ball hits him on the pads right in front of the stumps. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Remember, there is no DRS available for this series so if it's given out by the on-field umpire, it will remain the same. The debutant walks back cheaply and Pakistan in a spot of bother here.
Haris Sohail walks in at no. 3.

OUT! Edged and taken! Boyd Rankin draws first blood for Ireland in Test cricket. What a delivery to bowl. Bounce, movement off the pitch and it gets rid of the dangerous Azhar Ali. Rankin lands it on a length around off, the ball shoots off the surface and also straightens a touch. Ali hops and tries to keep it out off the back foot but is squared up. The ball takes the outside edge and goes into the hands of second slip. Porterfield there makes no mistake. An early wicket for Ireland and they are all pumped up.
Good length again on off, Ali guides it to gully. The Irish bowlers have kept it nice and tight until now.
On leg stump, Imam nudges it through square leg and gets to the other end.
On middle stump, Imam works it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Shortens his length on off, Imam stands tall and blocks it out.
Fuller in length on off, Imam pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes back to bowling it outside off and on a length. Ali does not fiddle with it.
Bowls it a little too straight and pays the price. Ali flicks it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Third leave in a row! The outswinger but from outside off. Ali shoulders his arms to it.
Closer to the off pole this time but not close enough to make the batsman play.
This is way outside off, left alone.
On a length around off, kept out.
A bumper to finish! Good change in length there by the bowler. Imam though was up for it as he evades it well.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, Azhar tries to flick but once again fails to play that shot. The ball hits his pads and goes down to fine leg. The batsmen take a run and the umpire signals a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Again hits the length hard and also gets it to straighten. Azhar tries to block but gets an outside edge which goes on the bounce to gully.
Good length on off, Imam tries to block it but it goes off the inner half towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length and just outside off, Ali presses forward and pushes it off the outer half of the bat towards gully.
Drifting a bit around leg, clipped off the pads down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around middle and off, shows a straight bat.

FOUR! Nicely driven! What a way to announce you name as a Test cricketer. Overpitched on off, Imam bends his back knee, leans ahead to the pitch of the delivery and unfurls a cracking cover-drive. It speeds away to the fence for a boundary, first one of the Test.
Slightly fuller and around middle and off, pushed firmly back to Murtagh who mimes a throw back at the batsman.
On a good length and around middle and leg, defended nicely off the front foot back to the bowler.
Good length on middle, Azhar taps it towards mid-wicket. He wants a run but seeing the fielder get to the ball quickly, the non-striker sends him back in time. Good call, there was never a run there.
It is bowled outside off, Ali need not play at those.
Outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Goes fuller this time and attacks his stumps, Azhar though gets his bat down in time.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length outside off, Azhar makes a leave.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length on off, Imam pushes it towards covers and wants a run but is sent back. He will be eager to get off the mark here.

NOT OUT! Imam is in but clever from the keeper there. Murtagh lands it on a length around off, it shapes away a touch. Imam lunges forward to defend but gets beaten. He is wandering outside his crease and Niall spots that. He underarms a throw at the stumps at his end and hits. However, Imam seems to have got back in time. The umpires go upstairs to check and replays show Imam-ul-Haq is well in.
Smart work from the keeper! Has he found Imam short of his crease? They have gone upstairs to check.
Walks down the track to negotaite the swing. Ali taps it towards cover-point for a quick run.
Length ball around off, Ali lunges and blocks it out.
Nicely bowled! This one comes in a touch from the off pole. It tails back in late. Azhar tries to keep it out but misses to get hit high on the pads.
This is even wider outside off, Imam makes another leave.
A little too wide outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Good length on off, the southpaw keeps it out off the back foot.
Hits the length hard on off, gets it to bounce a little extra due to his height. Imam makes a leave.
Fuller this time but does not get any movement. Imam defends the ball which is on off stump towards covers.
Not the ideal line to start off with as he bowls this one down the leg side. Ali misses the flick, the ball brushes the pads and goes towards fine leg. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Boyd Rankin will bowl from the other end.
He ends it well. Lands it on a length around off, Imam defends it solidly.
Bowls the outswinger this time by landing it on off. Imam once again pokes at it but gets beaten. A good opening over by Murtagh so far.
Good delivery and it is a good leave. It is bowled on a length around off, comes back in a touch. Imam trusts the bounce of the wicket and makes a good leave as the ball goes over the off pole.
Goes fuller in length on middle, Imam lunges and pushes it to mid off.
Play and a miss! Good use of the angle by the pacer. He lands it on a length around off, it slants away from the batsman. Imam has a feel for it and gets beaten.

The physio is out to have a look. Does not really look good at the moment. Not to forget it is his debut today. The ice pack is now out and it is being applied on his neck. The good thing is now he is up on his feet and he seems good enough to continue.

A collision on the first ball and it is a bad one. Imam-ul-Haq is down on the ground. Murtagh bowls a yorker on off. Ali jams it out towards the leg side and the batsmen go for a run. Imam dives to get back in but he is sandwiched by two players, the keeper who tries to kick the ball onto the stumps and the fielder who comes running in from point.

We are all set for the action to begin. The players make their way out to the middle along with the umpires. The two openers for Pakistan are Azhar Ali and Imam-ul-Haq. The former will be on strike and he will face Tim Murtagh who will bowl the first over for Ireland in Test cricket. Here we go...
TOSS - Ireland win the toss and elect to bowl first.

They are up against a Pakistan side which is facing a downward spiral in the red ball cricket. They were placed at the no. 1 spot in the Test rankings sometime ago but now have slipped to 7th on the table. They still are a formidable unit though and they head into this contest as clear favorites but a surprise is something you can't rule out. Welcome to the coverage of the first and only Test between the two in Dublin.

After rain played spoil sport on the first day, we have a good news for you today. It is bright and sunny at the moment and we expect a full day of cricket. The wait is over for the Irish fans as they will finally witness their country playing the Test cricket for the first time. They would want to prove their mettle and show the world they belong amongst the elites.
